# eks (cloudspider-upgrade) v1.1.0

One small EKS cluster so Cloud Spider can draw it and the bill can name it. Not the test VPC.

## Inputs

Set with `pulumi config set <key> <value>` or the STACKS card. Validated before any resource is created (upgrades/schema); the card runs the same check before it makes the stack.

| key | allowed | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| clusterName | must be a short lowercase name (a-z, 0-9, -; 2-28 chars, starts with a letter) | cloudspider-up | EKS cluster name; the stack is eks-<name> (cloudspider-up: upgrade) |
| instanceType | t4g.small \| t4g.medium | t4g.small | node instance type (Graviton) |
| nodeCount | 1..10 | 1 | managed nodes (in place) |
| maxPods | auto \| 32 \| 58 \| 110 | auto | kubelet pod cap; a number replaces the node group once |
| capacityType | ON_DEMAND \| SPOT | ON_DEMAND | SPOT uses a pool of similar types; auto maxPods then means 32 |
| vpcCni | on \| off | on | VPC CNI add-on |
| prefixDelegation | on \| off | on | VPC CNI prefix delegation (needed for maxPods numbers) |
| networkPolicy | on \| off | on | NetworkPolicy enforcement by the VPC CNI |
| podIdentityAgent | on \| off | on | EKS Pod Identity agent add-on |
| metricsServer | on \| off | on | metrics-server add-on |
| ebsCsiDriver | on \| off | on | EBS CSI driver add-on |
| controlPlaneLogs | on \| off | off | api/audit/authenticator logs to CloudWatch |
| logRetentionDays | 1..3653 | 7 | control plane log retention |
| vpcCidr | must be a /16 or /17 CIDR, like 10.43.0.0/16 (subnets /24 or /25) | 10.43.0.0/16 | VPC range (/16 or /17, private); changing it replaces the VPC and the cluster |
| adoptAddons | text |  | set by scripts/migrate-eks-addons.mjs |
| adoptPhase | import \| retag | import | set by scripts/migrate-eks-addons.mjs |

## Outputs

- `name`
- `viewerRoleArn`
- `versionOut`
- `nodeGroup`
- `eksAddons`
- `podsPerNode`
- `vpcCniPrefixDelegation`
- `vpcCniNetworkPolicy`
- `nodeCapacity`
- `controlPlaneLogTypes`
- `SCANNER_ROLE`
- `SCANNER_RULES`

- Providers pinned: `@pulumi/aws` 7.50.0, `@pulumi/kubernetes` 4.34.2, `@pulumi/pulumi` 3.268.0 (package-lock.json).
- No data resources to protect.
- Policy pack: `pulumi preview --policy-pack ../policy-pack`.
- Tested under Pulumi mocks: upgrades/iac-matrix.json.
